newsitem.title: USA: Techs bounce, take Nasdaq higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Techs bounce, take Nasdaq higher at close.

text.p: A bounce in some of the high technology stocks following Tuesday's sell-off took Nasdaq stocks to a higher close on Wednesday.
The Nasdaq Composite was up 4.25 points, or 0.34 percent, at 1260.78 at its unofficial close while declines led advances by 2146 to 2078 on volume of about 582 million shares.
High techs regained lost ground from yesterday's drubbing and also benefited from several brokerage updates.

Intel Corp, which had led the techs lower failed to score a turnaround today and closed down 1-1/2 at 119-1/2 but Microsoft Corp was up 3-1/4 at 145 and Dell Computer Corp rallied 3-3/4 to 92-3/8 after Bear Stearns raised its rating on the stock to buy from attractive.
Sun Microsystems Inc shares fell as much 4.9 percent in trading after the computer maker cut prices on some of its most popular models. Shares were down 3-1/2 at 57-7/8.
Another big over-the-counter winner was Medex Inc which rallied eight to 23-1/4 after Furon Co said it signed a definitive agreement to merge unit FCY Inc with Medix in a deal valued at $160 million.
